title_sq: Okazion Kleringu! Tek Ish Fusha E Aviacionit, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Mundesi Ideale Investimi Dhe Banimi !!
description_sq: Okazion Kleringu! Tek Ish Fusha E Aviacionit, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Mundesi Ideale Investimi Dhe Banimi !! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 1 banim dhe ka siperfaqe totale 107.3 m². Organizohet ne nje korridor hyres qe ben shperndarjen e ambienteve, salloni i bollshem i ndenjes me kendin e gatimit dhe dalje ne ballkon, dhoma matrimoniale me tualet me vete, dhome femijesh me dalje ne ballkon dhe tualeti i dites. Kompleksi ofron hapesira rekreative, hapesire lojerash per femije dhe shume sherbime dhe facilitete per nje jetese sa me te mire ne komunitet. Aktualisht ndertimi eshte ne faze ndarje me tulle. Zona ku ndodhet eshte nga me te preferuarat ne Tirane per shkak te ndertimit me nje plan ku jane respektuar shume mire hapesirat dhe aksesi.
title_en: Clearing opportunity! At the Former Aviation Field, 2+1+2 Apartment for Sale, Ideal Investment and Residential Opportunity!!
description_en: Clearing opportunity! At the Former Aviation Field, 2+1+2 Apartment for Sale, Ideal Investment and Residential Opportunity!! The apartment is located on the 1st residential floor and has a total area of ​​107.3 m². It is organized in an entrance corridor that divides the premises, a spacious living room with a kitchenette and access to the balcony, a matrimonial room with its own toilet, a children's room with access to the balcony and a day toilet. The complex offers recreational areas, play areas for children and many services and facilities for a better life in the community. Currently, the construction is in the phase of dividing with bricks. The area where it is located is one of the most preferred in Tirana due to the construction with a plan where spaces and access are well respected.
